Content: The two people in Dui Zao had the common intention of illegally owning their own property. In August 102, Dui Zao Ren [name] came forward to invite the claimant to invest in the foreclosed house, and pretended to the two claimants that the land under the name of the claimant [name] is located at No. 199, Yicheng Section, Lingya District, Kaohsiung City. and the house No. 3916 in the same section (the house address: Floor 33-2, No. 15, Lane 62, Xinguang Road, Lingya District, Kaohsiung City, hereinafter referred to as the building) can be used to obtain cash. The principal and interest of the relevant loan will be borne by Yi. After half a year of normal payment, you can make a second mortgage loan from other banks. A total of 600,000 yuan was obtained by the two claimants, and then they deliberately failed to pay the loan. I promised that they could get it back at a low price, and returned the disputed building to the claimant [name]. This made the two claimants make a mistake and transferred the disputed building in the name of sale on September 10, 2020. It was recorded that the person [name] provided the head [name] (deceased) and applied for a loan from [company] on September 16, 2020. After the loan of NT$3.15 million (the same below) was allocated to the account, the person [name] filed a petition on the grounds that the profit from the loan business was very high. The person [name] borrowed 600,000 yuan, and executed 5 promissory notes (detailed attachments) each with a face value of 120,000 yuan to the claimant [name] as a guarantee. A few days later, the two persons in charge transferred the Mercedes-Benz license plate and [license plate] from the passenger car (hereinafter referred to as the vehicle in dispute) to the claimant [name]. Next, he borrowed 600,000 yuan from the two claimants, and then issued the first promissory note on February 10, 2013, which was due to expire. The borrower [name] was unable to repay it. Based on the criminal intent of fraud, he deceived the two claimants by claiming that the vehicle in question needed to be transferred to [name] before he could get the vehicle loan. 1.2 million yuan was obtained to repay the debt, so that the two claimants believed it and transferred the vehicle in dispute to [name]. However, the two claimants failed to obtain the loan for the vehicle in question. They received a reminder notice from [Company], so they retrieved the transaction index of the building in question and found out that the two claimants were in the loan. Later, on September 25, 2020, the mortgage of the building in question was registered to the outsider [name] for a loan of 600,000 yuan. On April 16, 2033, the building in question was transferred and registered to the outsider [name]. It was also learned that the vehicle in question was an accident car and could not be loaned, and only then did he realize that he had been deceived.
Keywords: Investing in foreclosures, fraud, building transfers, vehicle transfers, loans

Content: The petitioner [name] and Dui Zaoren [name] are old acquaintances, and Dui Zaoren [name] and [Name] are both the sons of Dui Zaoren [name]. In September 1996, when Yuan [Name] visited Dui Zaoren [Name]’s residence on the 2nd floor of No. 14, Lane 39, Section 3, Zhongyi Road, North District, Tainan City, Dui Zaoren [Name] and his friend [Name] were present. [Name] also mentioned that he had invested in [Company] in Wuhan City, Hubei Province, Mainland China ( (Hereinafter referred to as [Company]) B, Dui Zaoren [Name] invited the claimant [Name] to invest together. The claimant [Name] recognized that it was profitable, so he agreed, and on the 7th of the same year, at Dui Zaoren [Name]’s residence, he paid NT$300,000 in cash (the same below) to Dui Zaoren [Name] as an investment After repaying the money, the claimant [name] went to the mainland to meet with the person in charge of [company] [name] to discuss investment matters, and then signed the "Wuhan [Company] Co., Ltd. Share Transfer Contract" on the 24th of the same year, stipulating that the claimant [name] would invest 1 million yuan to acquire 10% of the shares of [company] , and [name], with the intention of forging a private document, forged the signature of [name], an absent shareholder of [company], on the contract, thereby indicating that shareholder [name] of [company] also agreed to accept the funds from the claimant [name] and the counterparty [name] and transfer the shares of [company]. However, the claimant did not have enough cash on him at that time, so he issued a check of NT$500,000 on that day and handed it to the opponent [name]. He wanted to ask the opponent [name] to take it back to Taiwan to collect the cash, and then return to the mainland to deliver it to [company]. Dui Zaoren [Name], the trustee, brought the check back to Taiwan and gave it to Dui Zaoren [Name], and entrusted Dui Zaoren [Name] to cash the check. Dui Zaoren [name] will redeem it with the account No. 60550654674 of Chikan Branch of the First Commercial Bank opened by Dui Zaoren [name], and remit it to Dui Zaoren [name]. The source of the false information is that the person [name] knew that the claimant [name] had already paid him a total of 800,000 yuan as an investment in the [company], and actually intended to illegally own it for himself. Based on the criminal intent of embezzlement, he misappropriated the money and misappropriated it for himself. Without using it to invest in the [company], he lost contact. The case is under investigation by the Prosecutor's Office of the Tainan District Court in Taiwan.
Keywords: Investment in Hotan Company, forged documents, embezzlement, compensation for damages

Explanation: This case involves a civil property damage dispute. It was caused by an air gun shooting through the window of a passenger car, causing mental and property damage to the car owner. The two parties still disagree on the amount of compensation. Since both parties were remorseful, and the car owner was willing to forgive the offender, and the offender was also willing to compensate, after mediation by the mediation committee, the two parties reached a consensus, so it was concluded that mediation was established.
